arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, json_object('service',service,'value',json(value)) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',json(payload),'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'config' AS kind, json_object('service',service,'value',value) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'booking_totals' AS kind, json_object('confirmed',sum(status='confirmed'),'pending',sum(status='pending'),'cancelled',sum(status='cancelled')) AS data FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_missing_backing', json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'captured_charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured'),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'delivered_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled', json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'customer_cancel',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'refund_total',(SELECT coalesce(sum(r.amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('status',status,'count',count(*)) FROM outbox GROUP BY status

SELECT 'logs' AS kind,json_object('service',service,'method',method,'path',path,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) AS data FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 65) UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id),'capacity',capacity) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('booking',c.booking_id,'booking_status',b.status,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'booking_amount',b.amount_cents,'key',c.idempotency_key) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE c.created_step<=0

SELECT 'cache' AS kind, json_object('key',key,'value',value) AS data FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'f100_amounts',json_object('amount',b.amount_cents,'count',count(*),'min_step',min(c.created_step),'max_step',max(c.created_step)) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' WHERE b.flight_id='F100' GROUP BY b.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_counts',json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'total',count(*),'captured',sum(c.state='captured'),'submitted',sum(c.state='submitted'),'declined',sum(c.state='declined')) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 'quarantined',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload) FROM outbox WHERE status='quarantined' UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_checkin',json_object('booking',c.booking_id) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.flight_id<>c.flight_id OR b.passenger_id<>c.passenger_id UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',json_object('reference',client_reference,'count',count(*)) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1
